packagingBaselinePolicy.futureGrowthRule: The approved first M2 artifact set becomes the future identically scoped nonzero baseline. Later artifacts must pass both their absolute gate and packaging-growth at 10 percent.
packagingBaselinePolicy.initializationRule: The first M2 shared-core artifacts have no percentage baseline. Each of the six exact leaves must pass its absolute gate with nonzero bytes and SHA-256; no zero-byte or fabricated predecessor is permitted.
